mapper.sql: id, batch_number, product_id, warehouse_id, supplier_id, operator_id, quantity, unit_price, total_price, remark, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_in_record SET batch_number = #{batchNumber}, product_id = #{productId}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, operator_id = #{operatorId}, quantity = #{quantity}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, total_price = #{totalPrice}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM stock_in_record WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT sir.id AS id, sir.id AS recordId, sir.batch_number AS recordNo, sir.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.specification AS specification, p.unit AS unit, sir.unit_price AS unitPrice, sir.quantity AS quantity, sir.total_price AS lineAmount, sir.supplier_id AS supplierId, sup.name AS supplierName, sir.operator_id AS operatorId, COALESCE(op.real_name, op.username) AS operatorName, sir.remark AS remark, sir.create_time AS createTime FROM stock_in_record sir LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = sir.product_id LEFT JOIN supplier sup ON sup.id = sir.supplier_id LEFT JOIN sys_user op ON op.id = sir.operator_id ORDER BY sir.create_time DESC, sir.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
